query:
SELECT source,
CASE WHEN source='edge_logs' THEN CASE WHEN startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/v1/object/sign/') THEN 'signed_URL_generation' WHEN startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/v1/object/') THEN 'object_transfer' ELSE 'other_storage' END
WHEN source='postgrest_logs' THEN CASE WHEN position(event_message,'PGRST003')>0 THEN 'PGRST003' WHEN position(event_message,'PGRST001')>0 THEN 'PGRST001' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'Thread killed by timeout manager')>0 THEN 'Warp_timeout_manager' ELSE 'other_timeout' END
WHEN source='postgres_logs' THEN CASE WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'pg_stat_statements')>0 THEN 'admin_pg_stat_statements' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'pg_stat_activity')>0 THEN 'admin_pg_stat_activity' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'pg_settings')>0 THEN 'admin_pg_settings' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'pg_catalog')>0 THEN 'admin_catalog' ELSE 'admin_other' END ELSE 'other' END AS operation,
CASE WHEN source='edge_logs' THEN CASE WHEN startsWith(log_attributes['request.headers.user_agent'],'Dart/') THEN 'Dart' WHEN startsWith(log_attributes['request.headers.user_agent'],'Deno/') THEN 'Edge/Deno' ELSE 'other' END ELSE log_attributes['parsed.application_name'] END AS family,
count() AS observations,uniqExact(tuple(timestamp,event_message)) AS unique_timestamp_message_pairs,min(timestamp) AS first_observed,max(timestamp) AS last_observed,
max(toFloat64OrZero(log_attributes['response.origin_time'])) AS max_origin_ms,
countIf(positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'statement timeout')>0) AS includes_statement_timeout_phrase
FROM logs WHERE (source='edge_logs' AND startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/'))
OR (source='postgrest_logs' AND positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'timeout')>0)
OR (source='postgres_logs' AND log_attributes['parsed.application_name'] IN('supabase/dashboard','mgmt-api') AND positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'timeout')>0)
GROUP BY source,operation,family ORDER BY source,operation,family LIMIT 30
